_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.113

SysID now checks current-probe pulses before reusing a quiet plateau, improving
long-window pressure-rate measurements when pulses emerge at lower pressure.
Probe duration, independent checks, calibration and firmware are unchanged.
This does not qualify unresolved partial beats or cross-cuff tuning transfer.
